\[
\vec{AD}=D-A=\left(-\frac12,-\frac{3\sqrt3}{2}\right),\qquad 
\vec{AE}=E-A=\left(\frac12,-\frac{3\sqrt3}{2}\right)
\]

\[
\vec{AD}\cdot \vec{AE}=-\frac14+\frac{27}{4}=\frac{13}{2}
\]

\[
|\vec{AD}|=|\vec{AE}|=\sqrt{\frac14+\frac{27}{4}}=\sqrt7
\]

Thus
\[
\cos(\angle DAE)=\frac{\frac{13}{2}}{7}=\frac{13}{14}
\]

So
\[
\sin(\angle DAE)=\sqrt{1-\left(\frac{13}{14}\right)^2}=\frac{3\sqrt3}{14}
\]

Therefore \(a=3\), \(b=3\), \(c=14\), and

\[
a+b+c=3+3+14=\boxed{20}
\]
